# Drone News 48h Brief — November 25, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 82 incidents._

## Summary
Over the past 48 hours, a significant number of drone incidents have been reported, particularly involving crashes and smuggling activities. Notably, several Amazon delivery drones have crashed into homes in Michigan, leading to investigations by the FAA. There is an increasing focus on the implications of drone technology in illegal smuggling activities, highlighted by a Kuwaiti court sentencing individuals involved in drone drug smuggling into prisons. Additionally, police forces across various jurisdictions have utilized drones for surveillance and assistance in arrests. The incidents illustrate a potent mix of technological advancements in delivery and security challenged by new risks, particularly in urban settings.
